scientific_scope.import_core: Parse mzML into BuildingMzMLMsScan records without project or GUI integration.
scientific_scope.mass_detection_core: Apply the exact public CentroidMassDetector array overload with an explicit noise level.
excluded_from_oracle: account, authentication, event, and cloud services

io.github.mzmine.taskcontrol.AbstractTas.reason: The oracle calls parseMzMl directly. Cancellation, scheduling, status propagation, and application task services are outside the scientific parser result and use an independently defined minimal lifecycle adapter.
preserved_members: cancellation flag queried by the parser

io.github.mzmine.util.MemoryMapStorage.reason: This type is referenced by public source but is absent from the frozen public source tree. The parser accepts null storage and the oracle uses that public path; no closed implementation is reconstructed.

io.github.mzmine.modules.io.import_rawda.reason: The oracle uses an independently defined no-filter, no-advanced-processing configuration. Manufacturer inference and GUI/batch configuration are excluded while the selected source MS level remains an explicit user setting outside the parser.

io.github.mzmine.datamodel.RawDataFile.reason: BuildingMzMLMsScan exposes conversion methods accepting RawDataFile, but the oracle normalizes BuildingMzMLMsScan values directly and never constructs or registers an application RawDataFile.

io.github.mzmine.util.DataPointUtils.reason: Only the array conversion helpers used by BuildingMzMLMsScan are retained. Feature conversion methods in the same utility class are unrelated and would pull the project feature model into the oracle.

io.github.mzmine.datamodel.featuredata.i.reason: Only public array/buffer conversion needed by parsed scan records is retained. Feature-series storage and memory-map lifecycle are outside the non-IMS parser oracle.

io.github.mzmine.main.MZmineCore.reason: Scientific data enums reference MZmineCore for display formatting. The oracle records canonical enum names and does not execute application bootstrap, GUI, account, event, or cloud services.

io.github.mzmine.modules.dataprocessing..reason: The oracle preserves and executes the exact public primitive-array overload. Interface, GUI parameter, isotope-below-noise, and MassSpectrum overload dependencies are outside the explicit centroid noise-level comparison.
GUI-backed parameter formatting and setup dialogs are excluded. The explicit numeric noise level is recorded in the differential settings contract.
